effective_row.label: Prestiti imprese
effective_row.source_contract: MFI lending to non-financial corporations — outstanding stocks, MFIs excluding Eurosystem, non-seasonally adjusted
effective_row.append_contract: append only strictly contiguous monthly observations after the stored PIT runtime tail; current-vintage revisions to already stored dates are diagnostic only and can never rewrite historical runtime values

reason: The exact ECB BSI NFC-loans series is identified and live-tested. Across the 31-month overlap used by the proof, 29 observations match the stored runtime exactly and 2 differ because the current ECB vintage revised 2026-06 and 2026-07. The automation contract is therefore explicitly revision-aware: stored PIT history is immutable and only strictly contiguous observations after the stored tail may be appended. CI run 38402698569 proved one safe append, 2026-08 = 5462800.13649583, on an ephemeral runtime copy with the complete historical prefix unchanged. Tracked runtime remained byte-identical and no publication occurred.
